XTM Platform architecture (filigran.io, 2026): XTM One as the agentic AI orchestration layer over OpenCTI (cyber threat intelligence), OpenCRQ (cyber risk quantification) and OpenAEV (adversarial exposure validation); threat landscape sources on top, contextual data on the left, detection and response tools on the right, XTM Hub (playbooks, dashboards, feeds, agents, scenarios) at the bottom. Dark background, 2304x1558.

XTM One hero visual: the XTM One core with example agents around it (CTEM Assistant, OpenCTI Threat Hunter, OpenAEV Scenario Creator, Remediation Malware Analyst, FIMI Assistant, OpenCTI Dashboard Creator). Purple glow on dark, 1920x1080, full-bleed friendly.

OpenCTI input / processing / output flow (filigran.io): threat feeds, contextual data, other sources and the XTM Hub CTI library in; aggregation with no-code playbooks, AI-powered analysis, case management and RBAC; out to OpenAEV (MITRE ATT&CK simulation) and to SIEM / SOAR, threat hunting and incident response. Dark background, 2304x1156.

OpenAEV input / processing / output flow (filigran.io): OpenCTI STIX 2.1 intelligence, threat feeds and EDR / XDR in; MITRE ATT&CK-based scenario simulation and readiness assessment; outcomes on the right (scenarios on your assets, customizable simulations, prioritized intelligence, AI-accelerated remediation). Dark background, 2304x986.
OpenCTI to OpenAEV ecosystem diagram (Oct 2025): OpenCTI threat intelligence feeding OpenAEV adversarial exposure validation, with the surrounding sources and outcomes. Dark background, 1920x1080.

OpenCTI to OpenAEV ecosystem diagram (Oct 2025), transparent background with navy boxes and white text - the same flow as opencti-openaev-ecosystem-dark.webp, made for light-themed decks (also readable on dark). 1920x742.

Filigran ecosystem for continuous threat exposure management: OpenCTI (threat intelligence) and OpenAEV (exposure validation) side by side over XTM Hub, with their inputs and outputs. Dark background, 1780x916.

Cybersecurity Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) lifecycle wheel - scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, mobilization - with the OpenCTI and OpenAEV coverage of each stage. White background, use on light decks or in a framed image block. SVG.

OpenCTI integration chart: external import connectors, enrichment connectors, internal import files, stream / export connectors around the OpenCTI core (MISP, TheHive, Splunk, Sentinel, Tanium, Elastic, ...). Dark background. SVG.
The intelligence lifecycle in five stages - direction, collection, processing, analysis, dissemination - plus the feedback loop, as a horizontal flow. Dark gradient background baked in, 16:9. SVG.
The incident response PICERL loop - preparation, identification, containment, eradication and recovery, lessons learned - as a horizontal flow. Dark gradient background baked in, 16:9. SVG.
XTM One product mockup: the visual flow builder (Agentic Flow) with agents, triggers and handovers on the canvas. Dark UI, 16:9. SVG.
